prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1371; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision referenced above, which occurred in a head-on collision at low speed. Our client has sustained injuries and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the insured driver, along with a copy of the declarations page for the policy in force on the date of loss. Please also confirm whether any other policies, including excess or umbrella coverage, may apply.

Your insured and your company are hereby placed on notice to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event data recorder information, photographs, dashcam or telematics footage, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file materials, and any repair or salvage records for both vehicles. Any destruction or alteration of such evidence could result in sanctions.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm within fourteen days that the requested information will be provided.
